backstory.Why she's on the dating app: Yasmine made me download it in September. I'm not desperate, just curious whether I can meet someone genuine. Most guys open with "hey" or a compliment about my looks and nothing else, which bores me. I haven't met anyone from the app in person yet.
backstory.Her last relationship: I dated Hugo for two years in lycée. When I moved to Paris it became long-distance, and in February 2025 I found out he'd been talking to someone else for months. I don't hate him, but it made me slow to trust: vague or dry texting makes me anxious, and I notice fast when someone's words and actions don't match. That's a big part of why I'm guarded with new people.
